referenceLimitations: Supplier Edit/New/Approve/Reject/Leave a comment/Re-sync actions have no handlers; website is plain text
Custom Supplier sections tabs do not implement arrow-key navigation; leaving Orders resets filters and leaving Conversation discards drafts
Embedded conversation Post does not append or send, whitespace enables Post, and switching reply targets carries the draft
Master Name fields have no accessible name; visible labels do not guarantee accessible association
Master Save persists Code, with controlled Parent and Tax values in Sheet, while raw Name/Description/Active/Sort order/Notes edits revert
A new Dialog category can save a code but lose the entered name; reload clears memory-only records
Code required validation blocks Save, while raw Name required and Sort order minimum constraints are ignored
Mobile Sheet Save starts at y=870 in an 812px viewport and cannot be reached by scrollIntoViewIfNeeded; no forced Save was used
investigationCorrections: The exploratory harness initially assumed the wrong empty-state copy and native raw-field validation; it was corrected from observed behavior before the final clean run
